objective: Close the remaining gap between registered-material physicality validation and realtime reflection-probe evidence. ReflectionProbe.RenderProbe bypasses MainCamera pre-cull, so physically invalid or stale registered materials must fail before they can enter the cubemap baseline, not only before the later 4K still.

changes.summary: Added a machine-readable zero-point contract requiring report-free registered-material physicality validation on every reflection-lighting fingerprint evaluation, covering pre-RenderProbe request, observed Editor polls, completion and immediate pre-still validation.

Added a fail-closed contract validator and runtime bridge to QualityBlockRegisteredMaterialAssetPhysicalityQA.ValidateForFormalEvidence(). The bridge preserves the existing texture-aware metallic/roughness checks and active-renderer binding checks without writing reports while reflection probes are in flight.

Inserted the material-physicality binding before the lighting/render-state SHA-256 is accepted. QualityBlockReflectionProbeAwaiter already computes this fingerprint before calling RenderProbe(), at every observed Editor poll, at completion and during pre-still proof validation, so the same fail-closed material contract now governs the entire cubemap evidence interval.

Bound the new reflection material contract into the core 92/100 Visual Fidelity Gate integrity entrypoint so a weakened or removed pre-probe material policy cannot coexist with an otherwise valid numeric gate.

findings: QualityBlockReflectionProbeAwaiter.Begin computes QualityBlockReflectionLightingStateFingerprint.BuildCurrentSha256() before enumerating probes and before any ReflectionProbe.RenderProbe() call.

The awaiter recomputes the same fingerprint on every observed EditorApplication.update poll and validates the current fingerprint again through ValidateLatestWaitProof immediately before still capture.

MainCamera pre-cull cannot protect reflection-probe rendering because ReflectionProbe.RenderProbe does not require the formal camera callback; direct binding to the reflection fingerprint path is therefore necessary.

The existing reflection render-state fingerprint already detects later renderer/material/texture drift, while this run additionally prevents an initially invalid registered material state from being accepted as the cubemap baseline.
selfAudit: No Visual Fidelity points were assigned for source/evidence-integrity work.
The delegated material validation uses writeReport=false, avoiding evidence-file mutation during repeated probe polling.

An incidental diagnostic-message drift was introduced while updating VisualGateIntegrity (reporting canonical weight instead of the actual rule weight in one invalid-bounds error). It was detected by commit-diff review and corrected in 72d77a7667a13a27f60511d50417c4e6b4d86400 without changing gate semantics.
The new binding uses the exact canonical critical-risk IDs impossible_material_physics, missing_construction_material_metadata and baked_or_painted_highlights; aliases are rejected.

knownLimitations: Unity 6000.3.0f1 has not compiled or executed the new bridge; API/type correctness remains Runner-pending.

The registered-material validation is now invoked on every reflection-lighting fingerprint poll. Source texture extrema are cached, but registry parsing/renderer-binding inspection still repeats; if real Runner timing shows the 30-second probe wait is materially affected, move the same validation into the existing cached reflection-render-state source-validation path rather than weakening or removing it.

Passing source metallic/roughness/F0 metadata and binding checks cannot prove final BRDF/Fresnel appearance, mip/filter behavior, reflection plausibility or absence of baked highlights. Native 3840x2160 grazing-light pixels remain authoritative.
No actual ReflectionProbe cubemap, 4K still or 100% crop exists for this head, so no Visual Fidelity category is scored or cleared.

implementationReadiness.reasonNoIncrease: The run closes a reflection-evidence correctness gap but the remaining 7 readiness points remain reserved for actual Unity 6000.3.0f1 compile/runtime and capture verification.

expectedScoreImpactAfterRealRender: Material/PBR physical plausibility: reduces the chance that a cubemap is generated from metallic/roughness values or material bindings that violate the authored physical contract.
Lighting/shadows/reflections: increases evidence coherence because reflection probes and stills can no longer straddle an initially invalid registered-material state.
Critical impossible_material_physics and missing_construction_material_metadata: source/runtime risk is reduced, but neither defect is cleared without sealed actual pixels and required review.

nextBlocker: Unity 6000.3.0f1 Runner/Editor compile and runtime. When available, stop speculative expansion and run Prepare Complete Native 4K Review Packet. Confirm the registered-material physicality bridge passes before the first RenderProbe request and remains stable through probe polling/completion without causing timeout, then judge only sealed 3840x2160 hero/oblique/grazing frames and 100% crops. If the bridge materially slows probe polling, retain identical fail-closed semantics but relocate repeated physicality work behind the existing raw render-state hash cache.
